source.name: City of Scottsdale Planning
source.currentRecordsNote: Rezoning cases are the ZN series of the city's planning case table (about 1,230 back to the 1950s). New filings are thin: about 6 rezonings since 2025-04, the newest submitted 2026-06-03. The requested change appears in each case's request text; the table's Zoning column is filled on only 141 of the 1,230 ZN cases (counted 2026-10-14), so no zoning column is shown. Some locations are a street or an intersection rather than a house number.
